testedState.worktreeBinding: All diagnosis inputs are bound individually by SHA-256 below.

findings.evidence: After supervisor completion the host sets failureStage to artifact-read, then executes the post-run fence, whole-tree assertion and four throwing file reads under the same stage.
The isolated runner catches every error, emits one fixed stderr string and sets exit code 1; it publishes no typed terminal outcome.
The four canonical reports are written concurrently as separate files. A child failure can therefore leave a missing, partial or incomplete set without identifying which boundary failed.
The canonical classifier intentionally accepts nonzero child exit plus a complete canonical failed Verification report as status failed; the contract forbids a simple early result.code rejection.

rootCause.protocolCause: The host lacks a failure-only child terminal receipt and collapses distinct post-child read boundaries into artifact-read.
rootCause.runtimeCauseAvailability: The retained evidence cannot determine whether the child failed before compileWorkspace, inside verify-all, in postconditions, during final staging validation, or while publishing an outcome.

repairContract.publication: fixed stale cleanup; same-directory temp create-exclusive; canonical bytes; file fsync; close; atomic rename; directory fsync; temp cleanup
repairContract.hostRule: A receipt can only refine a failure. Success still requires exit 0, receipt absence, complete canonical artifacts, semantic rebuild and exact canonical classification.

decision.next: Freeze one child terminal outcome repair package. Do not alter generic WorkspacePaths, canonical Verification artifacts, AppContainer executor or timeout.

invalidationRules: The diagnosis is bound to the exact live source and failed evidence hashes above.
A later typed receipt can refine the runtime failure but cannot convert the recorded vertical-v2 run to PASS.
Any implementation requires a separately frozen manifest and new focused evidence.
